title: One to rule them all: Towards Joint Indic Language Hate Speech Detection.

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance (Macro F1 scores) of monolingual and multilingual transformer models (XLM-RoBERTa, mBERT, DistilmBERT) on hate speech and offensive content detection across a high-resource language (English) and low-resource Indic languages (Hindi and Marathi) to address data scarcity and performance disparities.
